claim: Measured over an 18-case deterministic sample spanning the epoch, the z >= -4 branch boundary, both 400-year era boundaries (1600-01-01 = -135140, 1599-12-31 = -135141), the leap-century cases and both ends of the year domain: of the 18 cases 16 satisfy ok() and all 16 round-trip exactly through sys_days, year_month_day{-32767,1,1} maps to -12687428 and year_month_day{32767,12,31} maps to 11248737, and year(1,1,1) maps to -719162, confirming the epoch offset of 719468 days from 0000-03-01.
